description: This file contains extension methods for the CronSettings class, providing UI-related helpers such as status tint colors, schedule summaries, duration formatting, and next run labels.

classes.name: CronSettings
classes.description: A class or struct that manages cron job settings and associated UI helpers.

methods.name: selectedJob
methods.description: Computed property that retrieves the currently selected cron job based on the selectedJobId stored in CronSettings.

methods.name: statusTint
methods.description: Returns a SwiftUI Color based on the provided status string.

methods.name: scheduleSummary
methods.description: Generates a textual summary of a given CronSchedule.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Converts a duration in milliseconds into a concise human-readable string.

methods.name: nextRunLabel
methods.description: Provides a human-readable label indicating how soon the next scheduled run is, relative to now.
